order_wins: **Oriana Power** - receives **two Letters of Award dated 18 September from Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution for an aggregate 900 MW / 1,800 MWh of battery energy storage**, worth approximately Rs 3,870 crore over the 15-year purchase-agreement term _(~140% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Dilip Buildcon** - **declared the successful bidder by REC Power Development and Consultancy for a 400 kV GIS switching station at Solapur/Paranda, Maharashtra**, on build-own-operate-transfer terms, the filing putting the EPC scope at Rs 1,265 crore excluding GST _(~18.3% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Pace Digitek** - material subsidiary Lineage Power receives a **Letter of Award of Rs 488.46 crore including taxes from NTPC GE Power Services** for 5.015 MWh of BESS containers with battery and energy management systems and a 12-year maintenance contract, to be completed by 31 December 2026 _(~14.5% of mcap)_.

**Diamond Power Infrastructure** - secures **orders aggregating Rs 116.49 crore including GST from Polite Powertech for about 655 km of 11 kV XLPE cables** for underground distribution in Bhavnagar and Ahmedabad. Rs 79.83 crore of that total is conditional on the EPC contractor first receiving its own Letter of Award.

**Waaree Energies** - receives an **order for the supply of 2 GW of solar modules from what it describes only as a renowned customer and leading solar developer**; no value and no counterparty name are disclosed.

**Onward Technologies** - **renews a multi-year Managed Digital Services contract at Rs 44.46 crore with one of the world's leading construction and mining equipment makers**, a 72% increase in value, running August 2026 to August 2029 _(~7.0% of mcap)_.

**GK Energy** - receives a **Letter of Award from Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution for 150 MW / 300 MWh of battery storage** at Rs 2,38,000 per MW a month, which it puts at Rs 42.84 crore of yearly revenue excluding GST for 15 years from commissioning.

**Yaashvi Jewellers** - receives **contracts from R.S. Jewels and D'Diyas Jewels for the supply of gold jewellery worth approximately Rs 30.00 crore including tax**, for delivery by 31 October 2026 _(~21.7% of mcap)_.

**Kothari Industrial Corporation** - receives a **Letter of Acceptance from Tiruppur City Municipal Corporation to supply the Perunthalaivar Kamarajar morning breakfast scheme to school children**, at Rs 9.08 per packet, the Rs 24.93 crore value being an approximate three-year cost _(~1.6% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Complete Sports and Management India** - takes an **order from a large South India-based company to design, develop and construct what it calls India's first and largest indoor go-karting track**, valued at approximately Rs 24 crore _(~8.1% of mcap)_.

**Mini Diamonds (India)** - secures a **domestic order for cut and polished natural diamonds from an existing Mumbai-based client**, Rs 14.50 crore in the filing against the Rs 14.25 crore and the Aura Diamond name its exchange subject line carries _(~14.6% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Garment Mantra Lifestyle** - wins an **export order from Zaara Overseas FZE for polyester printed fabrics and cotton embroidery made-up dress materials**, about Rs 10.37 crore or USD 10,80,920, to be executed by 20 January 2027 _(~16.0% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**HEC Infra Projects** - receives a **Rs 7.45 crore work order from Nakshatra Infra** for electrical, HVAC, firefighting and fire-detection work at the museum at Old Lal Court, Vadodara, to run six months _(~5.8% of mcap)_.

**Dhruv Consultancy Services** - receives a **Rs 6.84 crore Letter of Acceptance from the National Highways Authority of India** to act as Independent Engineer supervising the four-laned Bodhre-Dhule section of NH-52 for 60 months.

**Value 360 Communications** - signs a **Main Services Agreement with Amazon Development Centre (India) for public-relations services worth approximately Rs 4.74 crore a year**, running 1 September 2026 to 30 August 2027.

**3C IT Solutions and Telecoms (India)** - receives a **Rs 2.36 crore purchase order including GST from a domestic co-operative bank for data-protection compliance services**, to be executed in 12 to 14 weeks _(~23.1% of mcap)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Neogen Chemicals** - completes its **first-ever Qualified Institutions Placement, 26,60,753 shares at Rs 2,255 raising approximately Rs 600 crore and oversubscribed 6.5 times**, with proceeds going to repay borrowings and fund working capital _(~9.2% of mcap)_.
equity_allotments: **Wheels India** - allots **12,32,031 equity shares at Rs 1,461 on a preferential basis, Rs 179.99 crore**, of which Sundaram Finance's TSF Investments takes 10,26,694 shares and moves from 25.01% to 27.81%; a fresh allotment, not a warrant conversion _(~3.4% of mcap)_.

**TD Power Systems** - allots **12,50,000 new equity shares at Rs 600 on a preferential basis, Rs 75 crore, to promoters Nikhil Kumar and Mohib Nomanbhai Khericha** following the 10 September shareholder resolution _(~0.3% of mcap)_.

**Emkay Global Financial Services** - allots **1,00,000 equity shares to promoter Prakash Kacholia on conversion of warrants** issued in October 2025, on payment of the balance Rs 179.625 a warrant; a past conversion, not new money raised.
m_and_a: **Samvardhana Motherson International** - board approves the purchase, through wholly-owned Samvardhana Motherson Adsys Tech, of **50.1% of Rotary Connectors, which makes military-grade circular connectors for aerospace and defence**, at an enterprise value of Rs 500.4 crore in cash _(~0.3% of mcap)_.

**Thyrocare Technologies** - board approves the **sale of its entire 100% holding in radiology subsidiary Nueclear Healthcare to Trovera Healthcare for approximately Rs 141.40 crore**, Rs 59.50 crore in Trovera preference shares and Rs 81.90 crore in cash, exiting radiology to focus on pathology.

**Himadri Speciality Chemical** - board approves a **scheme of arrangement demerging the tyre business of Dalmia Bharat Refractories into Himadri as a going concern**, with an appointed date of 1 October 2026 and new Himadri shares to be issued to Dalmia Bharat Refractories' shareholders; no value is stated.

**Rays of Belief (Mom's Belief)** - completes the **acquisition of 100% of New York-based paediatric early-intervention provider City Pro Group** through its US subsidiary; the filing puts City Pro's FY25 revenue at USD 11.43 million, about Rs 97.27 crore, against its own FY26 consolidated Rs 81.66 crore. No consideration is disclosed.

**Zodiac Energy** - completes the **acquisition of a majority 63.5% equity stake in Zenwatt Clean Energy**, which becomes a subsidiary with effect from 21 September, following the board approval of 9 February.

**Dixon Technologies (India)** - pays **Rs 2.55 crore to subscribe for 51% of newly incorporated Adivistar Electronics India**, an original-equipment maker of smartphones the company says deepens its foothold in the Android ecosystem alongside vivo.

**PDS** - completes the **transfer of its remaining 49% stake in DBS Lifestyle**, so that DBS Lifestyle, Suri Overseas and Pangram Brands Global cease to be associate companies from 21 September; no value is disclosed.

**Panorama Studios International** - executes an **assignment agreement with Ultra Media and Entertainment acquiring the dubbing rights to the film 'Anomie - The Equation of Death' in all Indian languages except Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada and Telugu**; no consideration is disclosed.

**Modison** - completes the **transfer of its entire holding in dormant wholly-owned subsidiary Modison HV to two promoters for Rs 27.68 lakh**; the subsidiary had nil income and Rs 28.26 lakh of net worth, and its cessation changes nothing in revenue.
capex_core: **Premier Energies** - **commissions a 7 GW N-type TOPCon G12R solar cell plant at Naidupeta, Andhra Pradesh across 101 acres**, built for about 88,000 cells an hour and taking total cell capacity to 10.6 GW, at a stated capital expenditure of Rs 3,293 crore _(~8.1% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers** - board approves a **capital budgetary outlay of Rs 2,896 crore for a greenfield shipyard at Raichak**, to raise shipbuilding capacity in both the naval and commercial segments _(~10.7% of mcap)_.

**Parag Milk Foods** - plans to **invest about Rs 100 crore to take paneer capacity from 20 to 80 MT a day at Manchar and Palamaner**, through brownfield and greenfield additions expected to be commissioned by June 2027.

**Marine Electricals (India)** - **inaugurates a sixth manufacturing plant in Goa across about 160,000 sq ft**, making power train units for data centres and shore conversion systems for ports, with full capacity of roughly 800 units a year targeted by March 2027.

**Lloyds Metals and Energy** - board approves **raising DRI capacity at Ghugus to 8,15,000 MTPA and at Konsari to 92,400 MTPA**, taking the company past 9,00,000 MTPA through debottlenecking rather than new plant; no capital figure is given.

**Shree Rama Multi-Tech** - **commences commercial production on a new tubing machine at Moti-Bhoyan**, adding 1.15 crore tubes a month to an existing 7.70 crore running at 90% utilisation, for a stated Rs 20 crore funded from internal accruals.

**BASF India** - reports that **BASF SE is in the advanced stages of a feasibility study for an MDI production complex in India and has secured industrial land at Dahej, Gujarat**; the final investment decision awaits that study and approvals.
credit_rating_changes: **Welspun Enterprises** - **CRISIL upgrades its long-term rating to AA/Stable from AA-/Positive on Rs 2,600 crore of bank facilities**, and lifts material subsidiary Welspun Michigan Engineers to AA-/Stable from A+/Positive.
**Jai Balaji Industries** - **CRISIL downgrades it to BBB/Stable from BBB+/Stable on the long term and to A3+ from A2 on the short term**, across Rs 995 crore of rated bank loan facilities.
business_updates: **Results season** — 10 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Biocon** - subsidiary Biocon Biologics wins a **positive CHMP opinion from the European Medicines Agency recommending marketing authorisation for its pertuzumab biosimilar Pebrilzo in HER2-positive breast cancer**, the first monoclonal antibody biosimilar cleared under the EMA's tailored clinical approach.

**Akiko Global Services** - reports **estimated consolidated turnover of Rs 27.77 crore for August 2026, up 106% year on year**, taking April-August to Rs 121.97 crore against Rs 45.74 crore a year earlier.

**Hy-Tech Engineers** - posts **Q1 FY27 revenue of Rs 43.0 crore, up 13%, and profit after tax of Rs 4.6 crore, up 11%**, and proposes wholly-owned subsidiaries in Delaware and Frankfurt plus about 6.5 acres near Shirwal, Satara.

**Iris Clothings** - enters an **agreement with Amazon to sell its Doreme kidswear range on the platform**, adding to a network of over 140 distributors and retail presence in 26 states; no value is disclosed.

**Persistent Systems** - earns the **Databricks Brickbuilder Specialization for banking, financial services and insurance**, citing a merchant risk and fraud detection solution and more than 1,000 Databricks certifications.

**Desco Infratech** - is **empanelled by the New & Renewable Energy Development Corporation of Andhra Pradesh as an approved supplier of 1 KWp to 500 KWp grid-connected rooftop solar plants**; the filing states this is not itself an award of any project or order.

**Smarten Power Systems** - unveils **seven power products at REV Expo Lucknow**, spanning hybrid, on-grid and backup applications and including the in-house On-Grid Star 3 kW, and reports about 10,000 visitors across the three days.
distress_risk: **Dai-Ichi Karkaria** - receives an **income-tax penalty order under section 270A of Rs 15.18 lakh for assessment year 2024-25**, on Rs 90.93 lakh treated as under-reported income, and says it will appeal to the Commissioner (Appeals).
